reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: The purpose of the TAF is to support Omnivore’s investment strategy of building profitable, scaling, and socially responsible climate adaptive businesses that serve base of the pyramid markets, support greater gender integration through targeted techncial assistance interventions and provide a financial return to Omnivore and its investors. The TAF strategy for Omnivore will seek to support projects that 1) drive smallholder profitability, 2) improve farmer resilience, 3) drive agriculture sustainability 4) catalyse climate action and 5) support agtech ecosystem initiatives.
